decisions.finding: Official Dacia Poland current model pages still expose Hybrid 155 for Sandero Expression, Sandero Journey, Sandero Stepway Expression and Sandero Stepway Extreme.

The current Dacia Poland model pages show the same gross starting prices already materialized from the 11.08.2026 price list: Sandero Expression 84,600 PLN; Sandero Journey 90,200 PLN; Stepway Expression 90,700 PLN; Stepway Extreme 96,800 PLN.
decisions.evidence: Current official model pages searched on 2026-09-19.

decisions.finding: The public configurator pages are readable and expose current selectable/default equipment for the configurations they expose, but this session does not provide a reliable reproducible mechanism to switch every version/engine combination and enumerate the complete Hybrid 155 option dependency tree. Do not convert the current default configuration into historical 11.08.2026 master observations.
No current-web observation is being written into the dated 11.08.2026 master dataset merely because it is visible now. Historical source boundaries remain intact.

The current public Sandero configurator exposes TCe 100, while the current Stepway configurator exposes TCe 110 and Eco-G 120. Neither public configurator page exposes Hybrid 155 as a selectable engine in the page content available to this session.

The current gap reassessment found no new source-backed master-data change that can be safely added without either a dated source establishing the historical effective date or a reproducible interactive configurator capture for Hybrid 155.

next_actions: Obtain a reproducible interactive configurator session capable of switching Sandero/Sandero Stepway versions and engines, then enumerate Hybrid 155 option states and dependencies if the configurator exposes them.
Reconcile any interactive results against the 11.08.2026 equipment matrix before creating new master rows.
Keep current-web observations in reporting/provenance unless a dated source establishes their effective date.
